sections.title: Main Quest
sections.note: Eight dungeons, each with an Instrument of the Sirens, and the keys that open them.

items.name: The Sword
items.howTo: Tarin gives back your Shield when you wake in Mabe Village. Go south to Toronbo Shores and walk along the beach to the east to find the Sword.
items.notes: The Owl appears for the first time once you have it.

items.name: The Tail Key
items.howTo: Take the Sleepy Toadstool to Syrup at the Witch's Hut for Magic Powder, sprinkle it on the Raccoon (Tarin) blocking the forest path, then open the chest in the north of the forest.

items.name: Tail Cave (Level 1)
items.howTo: Open the keyhole south of Mabe Village with the Tail Key.
items.notes: Boss: Moldorm. Dungeon item: Roc's Feather.

items.name: Rescue BowWow
items.howTo: Madam MeowMeow's BowWow has been kidnapped. Fight through the Moblin Hideout and beat the Moblin Chief.
items.notes: BowWow eats the Goponga Flowers that block Bottle Grotto.

items.name: Bottle Grotto (Level 2)
items.howTo: Walk BowWow through Goponga Swamp so he eats the flowers in the way; no key is needed.
items.notes: Boss: Genie. Dungeon item: Power Bracelet. Afterwards take BowWow home to Madam MeowMeow.

items.name: The Slime Key
items.howTo: Trade Kiki the Bananas so the monkeys build the bridge to Kanalet Castle, collect the five Golden Leaves there and give them to Richard at his villa. Go through to Pothole Field and dig at the Owl Statue with the Shovel.
items.notes: The leaves are in Items & Equipment, the Bananas in the Trading Sequence. The Shovel is 200 Rupees at the Town Tool Shop.

items.name: Key Cavern (Level 3)
items.howTo: Open the keyhole by the cavern with the Slime Key.
items.notes: Boss: Slime Eye. Dungeon item: Pegasus Boots.

items.name: The Ocarina
items.howTo: Enter the Dream Shrine in Mabe Village, sleep in its bed and cross the dream room with the Power Bracelet and Pegasus Boots. Then learn the Ballad of the Wind Fish from Marin.
items.notes: Songs are in their own tracker.

items.name: Wake the Walrus
items.howTo: Take Marin past Animal Village to the Walrus blocking the way into Yarna Desert, and she sings it awake.
items.notes: On Game Boy and DX Marin only comes along once you've traded the Honeycomb (Zelda Wiki); on Switch she comes either way. Marin's DX photos are lost after this.

items.name: The Angler Key
items.howTo: Beat the Desert Lanmola in Yarna Desert.

items.name: Angler's Tunnel (Level 4)
items.howTo: Put the Angler Key in the keyhole on Tal Tal Heights to stop the waterfall, then drop in from the cliff above.
items.notes: Boss: Angler Fish. Dungeon item: Flippers.

items.name: The Ghost
items.howTo: The Ghost follows you out of Angler's Tunnel. Take him to his old home, the House by the Bay, then to his grave in the Cemetery.
items.notes: Guides do this before Catfish's Maw. On Switch he gives a Fairy Bottle at the grave.

items.name: Catfish's Maw (Level 5)
items.howTo: Swim to the middle of Martha's Bay and dive into the catfish's mouth; no key is needed.
items.notes: Boss: Slime Eel. Dungeon item: Hookshot. The Hookshot is taken back from Master Stalfos after four fights.

items.name: The Face Key
items.howTo: Swim to the Ancient Ruins, open the Southern Face Shrine and beat the Armos Knight. Read the relief on the wall.
items.notes: The relief tells you the island is a dream.

items.name: Face Shrine (Level 6)
items.howTo: Open the Face Shrine north of the Ancient Ruins with the Face Key.
items.notes: Boss: Facade. Dungeon item: Power Bracelet L-2. The bracelet is the Powerful Bracelet on Switch.

items.name: The Flying Rooster
items.howTo: Push the Weathercock in Mabe Village aside with the L-2 bracelet and play Frog's Song of Soul at the grave beneath it.
items.notes: Frog's Song of Soul is 300 Rupees from Mamu in the Signpost Maze.

items.name: The Bird Key
items.howTo: Carry the Flying Rooster to the cave on Tal Tal Heights and fly over the pit to the chest.

items.name: Eagle's Tower (Level 7)
items.howTo: Use the Bird Key in the keyhole at the far east of the mountains: the tower turns to show its ladder.
items.reward: Organ of Evening Calm, Heart Container
items.notes: Boss: Evil Eagle. Dungeon item: Mirror Shield. Grim Creeper, the mini-boss, rides the Evil Eagle.

items.name: Wake Turtle Rock
items.howTo: Walk the west of the mountains to Turtle Rock, blocking the Flame Fountain's heat with the Mirror Shield, and play Frog's Song of Soul to the stone head. Beat it to open the way.

items.name: Turtle Rock (Level 8)
items.howTo: Enter through the defeated turtle's head; no key is needed.
items.notes: Boss: Hot Head. Dungeon item: Magic Rod.

items.name: The Egg's path
items.howTo: Read Dark Secrets and Mysteries of Koholint in the Mabe Village Library with the Magnifying Lens. It gives the way through the Egg's maze.
items.notes: The path is set per save file. The Magnifying Lens ends the Trading Sequence. On Switch the maze stays dark without the book (Zelda's Palace).

items.name: The Wind Fish's Egg
items.howTo: Play the Ballad of the Wind Fish at the Egg on Mt. Tamaranch with all eight instruments, follow the book's path through the maze, beat the Shadow Nightmares and play the Ballad again.
items.notes: Boss: the Shadow Nightmares: Giant Gel, Agahnim's Shadow, Moldorm's Shadow, Ganon's Shadow, Lanmola's Shadow and DethI. Waking the Wind Fish ends the game.
